text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but gains alone are not a sound reason to sell; consider the position's role in my overall account.","Avoid treating each stock as a separate account: my average cost is personal history, not a guide to what the stock will do next.","My account fluctuated despite making no trades, reminding me that prices are unpredictable; avoid reacting to short-term moves or trading without a clear reason."]}
